Maya: Quick micro-sync 5: need final GA defaults on SLA, burst billing, docs MVP. 2 minutes.

Sanjay: I'll draft the SLA table. Suggest Hosted 99.9, Dedicated 99.95, Private negotiable.

Zoe: For billing: baseline per-token + burst multiplier after 5m sustained exceed. Propose 2x default.

Ellie: Docs: one-pager SLA, simple billing example, and a short "how we measure" section. I can ship drafts by Wed.

Rafael: Oncall routing: Hosted -> Platform SRE; Dedicated -> dedicated oncall first; Private -> SE + customer ops. Add that to SLA page.

Maya: OK let's lock defaults: Hosted 99.9, Dedicated 99.95, burst multiplier 2x. Any objections?

Sanjay: +1. I'll add exclusions for customer-managed infra.

Zoe: +1 but will validate cost impact.

Ellie: +1. Docs ETA Wed EOD.

Rafael: +1. I'll push alert stubs to the runbook repo.

DeployBot: CI: sla-docs/v0.7 deployed to staging at 1768889265.

Maya: Thanks team. I'll publish the GA checklist once the PRs land. If anyone has critical objections, flag by EOD tomorrow.
